etsy.title: Life Audit Printable | Score 8 Life Areas in 10 Minutes | Balance Wheel Worksheet, Self Reflection PDF, A4 + Letter + Tablet
etsy.description:
Ten minutes. Eight areas. One clear picture — and one thing to do this week.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT IT IS
------------------------------------------------------------
A 4-page printable audit. You score eight areas of your life 0-10, draw those eight numbers as one balance wheel, and finish with a single small move for the week ahead. Free.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHO IT'S FOR
------------------------------------------------------------
- Anyone who senses something is off and wants a quick, honest read on it
- People who think better on paper, or with a stylus, than in an app
- Anyone at the start of a month, a quarter or a new job who wants a baseline to come back to

WHO IT'S NOT FOR
- If you want a full programme, this is not it. It is four pages, and it is meant to be.
- If you want dated pages, a habit tracker or a daily layout, this has none of those.
- If you want software to do the thinking, this is paper and PDF. You do the thinking; the pages hold the structure.
- If you are looking for a clinical or diagnostic instrument, this is not one. See the note at the bottom.

------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT'S INSIDE
------------------------------------------------------------
4 pages, in this order:

1. Start here — the scope, and the one rule for scoring honestly
2. The eight areas — Health, Work, Money, People, Home, Growth, Play, Direction. Each with a one-line definition, a 0-10 scale to ring, and a line for "Why that number?"
3. Your wheel — a 120 mm eight-area wheel. Eight labelled spokes, rings at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10, and the full scale printed in every wedge, so you can mark any spoke without counting your way around the diagram. Then: lowest area, highest area, the one that surprised you.
4. One small move — the area you're picking, the one move you'll make this week, when exactly, how you'll know you did it, and a date to re-score in 30 days.

------------------------------------------------------------
HOW IT WORKS — THREE STEPS
------------------------------------------------------------
1. SCORE. Eight areas, 0-10, first instinct, for how it is right now — not how it should be, and not how it was last year.
2. SEE IT. Mark each score on its spoke and join the marks. The shape matters more than the numbers. You are looking for the dents.
3. MOVE. Take the lowest area, or the one that surprised you, and make one move this week. Don't fix it. Just move it.

------------------------------------------------------------
FORMATS AND SPECIFICATIONS
------------------------------------------------------------
- A4 printable PDF — 210 x 297 mm, portrait, 4 pages
- US Letter printable PDF — 215.9 x 279.4 mm, portrait, 4 pages. Laid out separately for the shorter, wider sheet; it is not a scaled A4.
- Tablet PDF — 1620 x 2160 px, portrait, 4 pages, with internal page links
- Undated. Print it as many times as you like, for yourself and your household.
- Ink-light: measured at 4.2% maximum ink coverage per page. No solid fills.
- Every page is designed to print legibly in pure black and white as well as in colour.
- Fonts are embedded (Fraunces, Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Mono, all SIL Open Font License 1.1). The licence texts ship with the download.

------------------------------------------------------------
COMPATIBILITY
------------------------------------------------------------
Prints from any PDF reader on Mac, Windows, iOS or Android. Print at 100% or "Actual size" — not "Fit to page", which rescales the sheet.

The tablet edition is a standard PDF intended for handwriting apps that import PDFs and let you annotate them, such as GoodNotes, Notability or Samsung Notes. Import it as a document, not as a photo, so the internal links and the text survive. We have not tested every app on every device, so we describe it as intended for those apps rather than certified with them.

No account, no software and no subscription is needed.

------------------------------------------------------------
FAQ
------------------------------------------------------------
Is it really free, and what is the catch?
Yes, it is free, and there is no catch. All four pages are here. Nothing is held back, nothing expires, and nothing needs buying to use it. We hope you like it enough to look at our paid products later — that is the whole business model, stated plainly.

Is a 4-page free audit worth ten minutes of my time?
That is the honest question to ask. Ten minutes gets you eight scores, one picture and one action with a date on it. If you want more depth than that, this is not the product that gives it — see "Next step" below.

Do I need a printer?
No. The tablet edition is built for a stylus. But it prints, and the wheel is meant to be drawn on.

Can I fill it in on a computer?
The PDFs are not form-fillable. They are designed for a pen or a stylus.

Will it work in my handwriting app?
It is a standard PDF, so any app that imports PDFs can open it. We have tested the internal links in the file itself, but not on every app and device — see Compatibility above.

Can I print it more than once?
Yes, as many times as you like, for yourself and the people in your household.

Can I resell it, share it or put it in my own bundle?
No. The licence is for your own personal use. You may not resell, redistribute, share the file publicly, or include it in any product of your own, free or paid.

Is this an assessment, a diagnosis or therapy?
No. See the note at the bottom of this listing.

------------------------------------------------------------
REFUNDS AND POLICY
------------------------------------------------------------
This is a free digital download, so there is nothing to pay and nothing to refund. Digital files cannot be returned once they have been downloaded. If a file will not open, will not print correctly, or is missing a page, get in touch and we will put it right or send you a working copy.

------------------------------------------------------------
NEXT STEP
------------------------------------------------------------
This audit gives you the picture. The Balance Audit takes all eight areas further: guided questions so the scores are honest, a gap map, three standing rules, a 30-day plan, and twelve monthly re-scores so you can watch the shape change.

The Balance Audit is not published yet. When it is, it will be in this shop. This free audit is complete as it is — the paid one goes deeper, it does not replace this.

------------------------------------------------------------
PLEASE NOTE
------------------------------------------------------------
This is a structured self-reflection tool. It is not a diagnosis, an assessment or therapy. If something here worries you, talk to someone qualified — that is a strong move, not a weak one.

Money here is about how you feel about your money, not advice about it. This is not financial advice.

------------------------------------------------------------
